Title: Hydroponic Nutrient Solution: ppm, EC, pH & When to Change
Description: Run a hydroponic nutrient solution at pH 5.5–6.5, EC about 1.2–1.8 for greens and 2.0–3.0 for tomatoes, 72–75 °F, and replace it every 1–2 weeks. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic nutrients solution, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic nutrients
